_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Read from the King James Version

description: Read a Bible passage word for word from the stored King James Version (or the World English Bible where held): one verse, a verse range, or a whole chapter, by reference. Use when the person names or implies a reference ("John 3:16", "Psalm 23", "1 Cor 13:4-7"). Not for finding verses by wording (scripture_search) or by feeling or need (verses_for), for a verse with its surrounding verses (scripture_context), or for linked passages (cross_references). reference takes one book and chapter with an optional verse or verse range inside that chapter ("Book C", "Book C:V", "Book C:V-W"); ranges across chapters are not supported. Deterministic. An unparseable reference returns an error suggesting scripture_search; a WEB request for a passage not held returns KJV and explains why in note. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

reference.description: Book, chapter and optional verse or range, as a reader writes it: "John 3:16", "Psalm 23", "Romans 8:38-39", "1 Cor 13:4-7". Common abbreviations are accepted.

translation.description: KJV (whole Bible, default) or WEB (World English Bible, held for a limited set of passages; otherwise KJV is returned with a note).

name: scripture_passage

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

note.description: Present only when WEB was asked for and KJV was returned instead.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

read_more.description: Web page where the passage can be read in full.

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

translation.description: The translation actually returned: KJV or WEB.

verses.description: Each verse number with its verbatim text.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: Scripture passage
